chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from ʿAlī ibn Ḥadīd and ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Najrān, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Ḥarīz ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Zurārah, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم used to perform the two rakʿahs of ṣubḥ—and that is al-fajr—when the dawn had spread across the horizon and had become well illuminated.

key_terms.اعْتَرَضَ: spread across horizontally; appeared across the horizon
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: When did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم pray the fajr prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم regarding the time of the fajr prayer. It indicates that he would perform the two rakʿahs of ṣubḥ when dawn had appeared broadly and become clearly bright, making it relevant to discussions of prayer timings in fiqh.
